transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is... I just hardly eat right anymore. I mean, some days it's really just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. And, uh, my pants are just hanging loose on me now. So I figured I needed to come in.
Are you avoiding food on purpose?

No, it's not on purpose. I'm not... I'm not trying to lose weight or go on a diet or anything like that. I just, uh, I don't really know why. I just don't have the urge to eat. I don't even think about food most of the day.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

Yeah, like I mentioned with my pants... they're just really loose on me now. I haven't stepped on a scale to give you an exact number of pounds, but it's got to be a lot. When you're only having coffee and maybe a piece of bread for the whole day, the weight just kind of falls off you.
Do you feel like you should be thinner?
No, not at all. I don't care about being thin or nothing like that. Like I said, I'm not trying to lose weight... it's just happening because I don't eat.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days I just wake up with this... this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It just feels like there ain't nothing good waiting for me out there, you know? I just want to keep my head down and not really deal with the day.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

Not really, no. I used to... well, I used to like walking down by the lake, or just working on my little model kits. But now they just sit there. I look at them and it's like... like they belong to somebody else. I just don't get any enjoyment out of doing any of that stuff anymore.
Has something very stressful or traumatic happened to you recently?
No, not really. Nothing bad or... or stressful has happened lately. Just regular life, I guess. I haven't been through nothing traumatic or nothing like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would make you happy?

Yeah, I mean... kind of like what I was just saying. I just can't get happy from any of it anymore. Even the stuff that used to make me smile, it just... it doesn't do nothing for me now. It's all just flat.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

Yeah, I do. A lot, actually. I just... I keep thinking I'm no good because I lost my job, and now my relatives have to step in and help me out with things. I hate it. I just sit around and replay every mistake I've ever made in my head. It's like... like I just ruined everything, you know?
Have you been having thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, no, I haven't. I mean, I feel real bad about myself, like I said, but I ain't having no thoughts about ending it or hurting myself. I wouldn't do nothing like that.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling and sad most days?
Well, I guess... this depressed spell has been hanging over me for about five months now. It's just been heavy like this since then.
Have you been feeling restless or slowed down in your movements lately?
Well, my family's been telling me I move like I'm walking through mud. Just real slow. And... sometimes it takes me a long time to answer even a simple question. I just feel slowed down all over.
Have you been feeling anxious or nervous lately?
No, not really. I mean, I don't feel nervous or anything like that. Just... heavy and slow, like I said. But not anxious.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Not really, no. I used to like walking by the lake, and... working on my little model kits. But now, they just sit there. I look at them and it's like they belong to somebody else. I just don't have any interest in them anymore.
